name: FCC 106 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 106, a dwarf early-type galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc106-hubble
story: FCC 106 is one of 43 early-type galaxies that Hubble imaged across the Fornax Cluster, a survey built to show how life in a cluster shapes the galaxies within it.

claims.text: FCC 106 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy observed by the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey
FCC 106 is an ACS Fornax Cluster Survey program galaxy, typed as a dwarf S0
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax Cluster with Hubble
The survey was designed to study the role of environment
